messages.author: 3710e46698fb1970
messages.subject: correlations in lavaan
parts:
Greetings, 

Is it possible to specify correlations for outcome, mediators and predictors in lavaan? After fitting the measurement model for two different latent variables, I will like to see correlations between these latent variables and my predictors and mediators before specifying directional path for the structural model. I will appreciate knowing if such correlations are possible in lavaan. 

Thanks, 
Alice.

messages.author: 5b9c62b1c7cbc1e6
messages.subject: Re: correlations in lavaan
parts:
Alice, you can use the lavInspect () function on the fitted object. Check the help pages,  but I think you want what="std" .

Pat
